info.title: WeApi CLI - Production-Ready Clean Architecture .NET 10 Starter
info.description: Production-ready cross-platform CLI tool to generate Clean Architecture .NET 10 Web API backends.

commands.name: new
commands.description:
Generate a new Clean Architecture Web API project.
version, --version     Show version and runtime environment.
help, --help, -h       Show help and command documentation.

options.name: --database
options.description:
Relational database provider:
'sqlserver'  - Microsoft SQL Server (default)
'postgresql' - PostgreSQL via Npgsql

options.name: --id-type
options.description:
Primary key identifier type:
'guid' - GUID / UUID v7 (default, recommended)
'int'  - 32-bit integer identity
'long' - 64-bit bigint identity

options.name: --output
options.description:
Output directory for the generated solution.
Default: ./<ProjectName>

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Display what would be created without writing files.
